statement: The operational-use gate depends on an "attributable competent legal approval" artefact, but no role, operation or channel can record one. Only Admin and User exist, User has no shared writes, and Admin action is explicitly not legal approval. The Vision still lists a "Researcher/content reviewer" needing a "correction and review queue" and a "Legal review workspace" mode with "review decisions". The gate does not say whether a designated legal-adviser decision suffices or formal JAG validation is required, though the controlling policy treats them as separate gates. The same gap covers who decides that a change is "credible material" and who re-enables a blocked scope. Result: fail-closed, so no template or advisory can become operational on an air-gapped site.

State how an approval artefact reaches a deployment (signed release import only, or Admin transcription of an external artefact with the artefact attached) and that recording is not approving. Name who decides credibility and re-enable. Mark the review workspace as Admin-operated or deferred. If undecided, list it as a blocking open decision in ADR-0003.

statement: Two update channels exist (external release bundle; local Admin upload) with one sentence on how they coexist. The ingestion design is policy/SOP-shaped: an Admin-uploaded amending Act or new judgment stays an `ADMIN_PUBLISHED_UNVERIFIED` source, and no path turns it into a `ProvisionVersion` or `Judgment` node on site, since `AMENDS_PROVISION_VERSION` needs an authenticated instrument.

statement: The relation table has `AMENDS_PROVISION_VERSION` only. It cannot express repeal, omission of a section, repeal-and-re-enactment correspondence (IPC to BNS, CrPC to BNSS, Evidence Act to BSA from 1 July 2024), commencement notifications, saving/transitional provisions, rules implementing an Act, or instrument-level supersession. The time model requires all of these. The existing corpus relation types (`amends`, `supersedes`, `repeals`, `overrules`, `implements`, ...) are not mapped. None of the project's known supersession cases is named as an acceptance case.
requested_action: Add the missing edge types (or state the table is non-exhaustive and list them as required), a mapping note to the existing relations vocabulary, and the known supersession cases as named temporal acceptance tests.
